settlement.name: Settlement
settlement.description: Turn a handful of settlers into a self-sufficient village.

antiquity.name: Antiquity
antiquity.description: Bricks, temples and aqueducts. The city grows up and out — fishermen work the water, villas need culture.

middle_ages.name: Middle Ages
middle_ages.description: Mining in the hills, smelters and universities. The crown of the city will be a cathedral.

renaissance.name: Renaissance
renaissance.description: Trade, art and science. Sheep on pastures give cloth, harbors export it, and theaters and observatories make the city a center of learning.

industrial.name: Industrial Era
industrial.description: Steam, coal and steel. Factories and railways turn the city into an industrial power — crowned by the Exhibition Palace.

modern.name: Modern Era
modern.description: Electricity changes everything: power plants, hospitals, department stores and the first skyscrapers.

information.name: Information Age
information.description: Computers, the internet and nuclear power. Electronics drive data centers, solar parks and vertical farms.

future.name: Near Future
future.description: Fusion, artificial intelligence and arcologies. The last step of civilization will be a spaceport.

first_wonder.name: First Wonder
first_wonder.description: Build a wonder of the world.

wonders_of_the_world.name: Wonders of the World
wonders_of_the_world.description: Build all six wonders of the world.

drought.name: Drought
drought.description: It has not rained for a long time — farms produce less food.

epidemic.name: Epidemic
epidemic.description: A disease is spreading through the city. Some residents left and the mood dropped.

fire.name: Fire
fire.description: A fire broke out in {building}. Repair it right away, or wait for the residents to fix it themselves?

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.description: A power plant failure — electricity production dropped for a few days.

bumper_harvest.name: Bumper Harvest
bumper_harvest.description: Excellent weather — farms produce more food.

ancient_ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
ancient_ruins.description: Construction uncovered ruins with valuable records.

patron.name: Patron
patron.description: A wealthy resident donated money to the city.

caravan.name: Merchant Caravan
caravan.description: Merchants offer {amount} × {resource} for {cost} — half the price.

immigrants.name: Immigrants
immigrants.description: A group of {amount} people wants to settle in the city. Accept them? It will take them a while to settle in.

festival.name: Festival
festival.description: The residents would like to hold a festival. It costs {cost}, but it lifts the mood for a month.

settlers.name: Experienced Settlers
settlers.description: The colony starts with 10 extra residents and more food.

cargo.name: Full Cargo Hold
cargo.description: More resources and money at the start.

settlement.name: Crash Camp
settlement.description: The ship crashed on landing and the databanks are gone. Build the first self-sufficient base from wreckage and ice.

antiquity.name: First Base
antiquity.description: Regolith bricks, the first memorials and water from ice. Algae farms grow on the ice fields.

middle_ages.name: Dome Town
middle_ages.description: Crater mines, smelters and universities. The colonists build their own cathedral — under a dome.

renaissance.name: Martian Renaissance
renaissance.description: Trade, art and science. Bioreactors make cloth and theaters stage plays about old Earth.

industrial.name: Red Industry
industrial.description: Coal from the depths, steel and railways across the desert. Mars becomes an industrial planet.

modern.name: Modern Mars
modern.description: Power plants, hospitals and the first Martian skyscrapers.

information.name: Interplanetary Network
information.description: Computers, nuclear power and news from Earth with a 20-minute delay.

future.name: Terraforming
future.description: Fusion and artificial intelligence. The interplanetary spaceport will send colonists even further.

drought.name: Dust Storm
drought.description: Dust has covered the sun — greenhouses produce less food.

epidemic.name: Martian Flu
epidemic.description: A virus spreads through the domes. Some colonists flew back and the mood dropped.

fire.name: Oxygen Leak
fire.description: Oxygen leaked in {building} and caught fire. Repair it now, or wait for the colonists to fix it themselves?

bumper_harvest.name: Record Harvest
bumper_harvest.description: Clear skies without dust — greenhouses produce more food.

ancient_ruins.name: Mysterious Artifact
ancient_ruins.description: Builders found a strange metal object. It turned out to be an old rover — still, its memory held valuable data.

patron.name: Billionaire from Earth
patron.description: An Earth billionaire sent money in exchange for a photo with the colony.

caravan.name: Trade Ship
caravan.description: A ship from Earth offers {amount} × {resource} for {cost} — half price.

immigrants.name: New Colonist Ship
immigrants.description: A ship with {amount} colonists has landed. Accept them? It will take a while to get used to the low gravity.

festival.name: Landing Day
festival.description: The colonists would like to celebrate the landing anniversary. It costs {cost}, but improves the mood for a month.

settlement.name: Awakening
settlement.description: The colonists woke from hibernation under a red sun. The forest is purple, the air smells sweet and something in the bushes is playing a flute.

antiquity.name: Settlement under the Red Sun
antiquity.description: Bricks, temples of two suns and aqueducts. Jellyfish are caught on the lakes.

middle_ages.name: Purple Town
middle_ages.description: Crystal mines, smelters and universities. The town grows among giant mushrooms.

renaissance.name: Proxima Renaissance
renaissance.description: Trade, art and science. Hexapods give wool and theaters stage plays about three worlds.

industrial.name: Centauri Industry
industrial.description: Coal from fossil mushrooms, steel and railways across the purple plains.

modern.name: Modern Proxima
modern.description: Power plants, hospitals and the first skyscrapers above the forest.

information.name: Network of Three Worlds
information.description: Computers and nuclear power. News from Earth takes four years — we reply anyway.

future.name: Home among the Stars
future.description: Fusion and artificial intelligence. The interstellar beacon will tell Earth we are home.

drought.name: Red Flare
drought.description: The red sun has flared — mushroom farms produce less food.

epidemic.name: Alien Allergy
epidemic.description: Nobody tolerates the purple tree pollen. Some colonists left and the mood dropped.

ancient_ruins.name: Ruins of a Native Civilization
ancient_ruins.description: Builders found real alien ruins. This time it really is not an old rover.

caravan.name: Hexapod Caravan
caravan.description: Traders from the neighboring continent offer {amount} × {resource} for {cost} — half price.

bumper_harvest.name: Mushroom Season
bumper_harvest.description: Mushrooms are springing up like mushrooms — farms produce more food.
